title: Felt piano
description: Plays the notes it receives with a piano from a sample set of the project (for example felt-piano); the sample set is pinned by its content hash so the song always sounds the same. It needs a sample set and gives audio.

parameters.name: set
parameters.doc: The built-in piano, or a sample folder of the project with note-named WAV files (c4.wav, f#3.wav...).

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.doc: The built-in piano plays one touch for now.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.doc: Level of a sampled piano. It applies to the built-in sound too.

parameters.name: humanize
parameters.doc: A little human feel: at 100 every note starts up to 6 ms early or late and up to 15 % louder or softer (deterministic from the seed). 0 plays exactly on the grid. Works for a sampled instrument and for the built-in sound.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A sample set folder with piano notes (parameter set, for example felt-piano), pinned by hash.
